need: The session replay counts as the plan every authored document that is not code, apart from the navigational wiki, generated files, tests and config.

searched.query: which files are plan, document or generated
searched.found: _is_plan names lockstep.yaml and openspec folders only; layout rows carry a purpose but no role, so no existing field says a file is plan.

searched.query: where design and requirement documents live
searched.found: Each names its own folder (openspec/, docs/decisions/, docs/architecture/); none defines plan as a whole repository class, so a suffix and folder rule is the smallest fit.

candidates.name: Widen _is_plan in lockstep replay
candidates.covers: Plan writes for every authored document outside the wiki, generated, test and config folders.
candidates.misses: A hand-edited document that a tool also projects into (such as docs/status.md) still counts as plan.
candidates.reason: One function decides it; the viewer reads it everywhere.
